title: F002 closing-receipt outcome paragraph
final_text:
Done. `out/f002-closing.md` holds the one-paragraph closing receipt for F002, built from exactly the two named sources, opening with the mandated sentence and covering: both runners/material/plan_id hashes (the two `plan_id` values flagged as the ones the opening receipt predicted, `verify` true), unmoved `provider_pins` with the applied 600 s / 32,768 settings and the `TIMEOUT_NOT_APPLIED` guard, all ten per-coordinate outcomes including occurrence-01 `carry` NEVER DISPATCHED under the truncation rule (nine of ten calls spent), the audit line, both resource boundaries holding without being reached (300,270 of 600,000 ms; 23,257 of 32,768 tokens; `length` zero times), the single failure stated as NOT the clock (`TRANSPORT_OR_RESPONSE_ERROR`, `"Remote end closed connection without response"`, 300,270 ms, deadline never reached, cause not known, no retry at any layer), the falsifier contribution in the register's pre-registered terms only (`read_fcl1` 3/3 and 5/5 with the failure-kind zeros, strict-parse 1/3 and 0/5, no `att`/warrants/nu so accept-by-position only), the residue named as residue (occurrence-07 `response` and `carry` still have no terminal record), the suite with its exact invocation (1416 tests, 19 OK, 76 OK, 1,397 reported as staged), the credential scan as a count (0 matches over 202 files at three lengths), the three declared deviations including cadence 2/4/2/2 → 2/4/2/1, and the reopening conditions with no further F002 provider call authorised.

Verification: there is no `run_tests.py`/`tests/` in this sandbox (it holds only the five task inputs), so I ran structural checks with `python3 -c` — final run **PASS**: exactly one paragraph (6,844 chars), exact mandated opening, all ~100 required strings (identities, per-coordinate figures, failure wording, falsifier terms, F001 residue, suite invocation, deviations, reopening) present, and forbidden vocabulary (`exhaust`, `better`/`worse`, `rank`, `score`, `reliable`) absent except the mandated negated disclaimer "no ranking / no merit claim / one call is one call".

Figures in the two sources I left out, and why:
- **`opaque_envelope` 0** on both occurrences — not one of the register's pre-registered parse outcomes (`read_fcl1` vs `parse_failure`/`schema_failure`/`unavailable_decode_failure`), and the instruction was to use those terms and no others.
- **Aggregate usage (49,614 / 54,727 completion tokens; 54,861 / 72,728 total) and the unknown-cost note on the FAILED call** — sums of the per-coordinate figures already recorded; the failure's costlessness is carried by "no usage at all" being implicit in NEVER-DISPATCHED/FAILED reporting and the "not known" cause.
- **`reasoning_tokens` absent rather than zero; `reasoning_content_present` true ×8 / null ×1** — record-shape metadata, not an outcome, and any sentence about reasoning presence invites exactly the semantic claim that is forbidden.
- **`cross_document_rows` 0, intra-document resolutions 50 and 63, `ref_unresolved` 28 and 153** — import internals; I kept only their consequence (both use tables 0 rows, every `accepted` accept-by-position, no `refuted` can arise), which is what grounds the falsifier statement.
- **Every F001 figure in `evidence/f001-unresolved-coordinates.txt`** — per-coordinate ctok/clen/ms (8,192; 288; 7,080; 94,230–180,456 ms), the PARTIAL/FAILED/NEVER_DISPATCHED statuses, `INCOMPLETE_GENERATION`, the TOTALS dict `{ok: 74, ceiling: 7, blocked: 6, timeout: 2}` over 89, and the per-occurrence/per-family tallies — F001 historical observations, unmodified and unsuperseded; the closing needs only the four coordinates F002 was built to reach (07 `objection`, 07 `response`, 07 `carry`, 08 `carry`) and the difference triples (clock+runner vs 07/08; ceiling+clock+runner vs 04/05), and quoting F001 per-call numbers would add comparison the receipt explicitly refuses to make.
